sec.title: AmnesiaStealer Gives Attackers Live Control of Victims’ macOS Browsers
sec.brief: S. 2 Million Israeli Records Sold as a New Breach Are 20 Years Old Jamf Threat Labs researchers disclosed AmnesiaStealer, a new multi-stage Rust-based macOS infostealer that spread through a counterfeit GitHub download page using the ClickFix technique. The lure looks convincing: correct GitHub dark theme, Octocat logo, “Verified Publisher” badge, and instead of a download button, it asks the visitor to paste a Terminal command. The same fake GitHub template has been observed in Atomic Stealer and MacSync campaigns, which means the lure infrastructure is shared across multiple malware families. “AmnesiaStealer runs in three stages: The first is a shell script that downloads and launches the payload. The second is a Rust infostealer that harvests the keychain, browsers, Apple Notes and Telegram. ” reads the report published by Jamf Threat Labs.
